reference: While the group was settling, someone struck the singing bowl.
sk: Kým sa skupina usádzala, niekto udrel do spievajúcej misy.
cz: Zatímco se skupina usazovala, někdo udeřil do zpívající mísy.
acceptable: {While|As} the group was {settling|settling down|getting settled|sitting down|taking their seats}, someone {struck|hit|rang} the singing bowl.
Someone {struck|hit|rang} the singing bowl {while|as} the group was {settling|settling down|getting settled|sitting down|taking their seats}.

mistakes.text: While the group {settled|settled down}, someone struck the singing bowl.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „while“ je pre dlhší prebiehajúci dej prirodzenejší Past Continuous: „was settling“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „while“ je pro delší probíhající děj přirozenější Past Continuous: „was settling“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “while”, Past Continuous is more natural for the longer background action: “was settling”.

mistakes.text: While the group was settling, someone was striking the singing bowl.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Krátky dej, ktorý preruší prebiehajúci dej, patrí do Past Simple: „struck“, nie „was striking“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Krátký děj, který přeruší probíhající děj, patří do Past Simple: „struck“, ne „was striking“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The short action that interrupts the longer one takes Past Simple: “struck”, not “was striking”.

mistakes.text: While the group was settling, someone striked the singing bowl.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Strike“ je nepravidelné sloveso: v Past Simple „struck“, nie „striked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Strike“ je nepravidelné sloveso: v Past Simple „struck“, ne „striked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Strike” is irregular: its Past Simple is “struck”, not “striked”.

mistakes.text: While the group was settling, someone {struck|hit} {into|to} the singing bowl.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „strike/hit“ nepatrí predložka: „struck the singing bowl“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „strike/hit“ nepatří předložka: „struck the singing bowl“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Strike” and “hit” take a direct object without a preposition: “struck the singing bowl”.

mistakes.text: While the group settling, someone struck the singing bowl.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „was“: Past Continuous sa tvorí „was“ + -ing, teda „was settling“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „was“: Past Continuous se tvoří „was“ + -ing, tedy „was settling“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “was” is missing: Past Continuous is “was” + -ing, so “was settling”.
